Before we are born, chondrocytes work rapidly to build protection into our developing skeletons. Then we are born, grow, and age. The older we become, the slower chondrocytes work. As chondrocyte activity flags over time, they eventually fail to adequately compensate for the daily wear and tear placed on joints by an active lifestyle. As a result, nearly everyone has some degree of cartilage breakdown by the age of 32 to 35. For centuries it was thought that the gradual deterioration made joint pain and loss of mobility an inevitable fact of aging. Cartilage can indeed be brought back to greater levels of health, strengthened and thickened if proper nutrients are supplied. There is one controlling principle in the effort to rebuild cartilage: There must be some cartilage with viable chondrocytes in the joint in order for repair to proceed. If prior joint surgeries have removed all cartilage, or if all cartilage in the joint has been worn completely away, then there would be no chondrocytes on site that could initiate the reconstruction process. But most damaged joints do retain a good measure of cartilage. They can benefit from Joint Vibrance.

name: Vibrant Health Joint Vibrance Orange Pineapple, 21 Servings | Comprehensive blend for cartilage support in an easy-mix dietary supplement powder with a fruity flavor profile
retailer_description: Joint Vibrance provides cartilage-building cells called chondrocytes with the proper nutrients necessary for construction of new cartilage and synthesis of hyaluronic acid. It is the most comprehensive formula to nutritionally support healthy joint function. The entire formula is truly remarkable, and provides sound nutritional support for joint health. Before we are born, chondrocytes work rapidly to build protection into our developing skeletons. Then we are born, grow, and age. The older we become, the slower chondrocytes work. As chondrocyte activity flags over time, they eventually fail to adequately compensate for the daily wear and tear placed on joints by an active lifestyle. As a result, nearly everyone has some degree of cartilage breakdown by the age of 32 to 35. For centuries it was thought that the gradual deterioration made joint pain and loss of mobility an inevitable fact of aging. Today?s science has shown us that the function of cartilage-building cells (chondrocytes) can be sustained as long as their nutritional requirements are met. Cartilage can indeed be brought back to greater levels of health, strengthened and thickened if proper nutrients are supplied. There is one controlling principle in the effort to rebuild cartilage: There must be some cartilage with viable chondrocytes in the joint in order for repair to proceed. If prior joint surgeries have removed all cartilage, or if all cartilage in the joint has been worn completely away, then there would be no chondrocytes on site that could initiate the reconstruction process. But most damaged joints do retain a good measure of cartilage. They can benefit from Joint Vibrance.

name: Numi Organic Aged Earl Grey Tea, 18 Black Tea Bags with Real Bergamot | Assam Black Tea with Bergamot Oil, Bright & Balanced
retailer_description: Bright, balanced, and unmistakably real. Numi's Aged Earl Grey opens with a robust black tea base and finishes with a bright, citrusy lift from real bergamot — no artificial flavoring, no perfume-like aftertaste. It's smooth enough to sip plain, bold enough to take milk, and holds its flavor beautifully over ice. That balance comes from time. We age organic Assam black tea with true bergamot oil for several weeks, allowing the citrus to fully infuse into the leaf rather than simply coating it. The result is a rounder, more integrated cup than teas flavored with bergamot essence alone. We start with fuller leaf, hand-plucked Assam from Tonganagaon, the largest organic Fair Trade tea estate in India. Larger leaves have more surface area to unfurl and steep evenly, releasing flavor gradually instead of the fast, tannic bitterness typical of machine-picked fannings and dust used in many tea bags. Sourcing from Tonganagaon also means your tea purchase supports Numi's Together for H2OPE project, which has brought clean water and sanitation to more than 6,500 farming families at the estate.
